name: Deployment Summary
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'apps/api/src/app/workflows-v2/usecases/upsert-workflow/upsert-workflow.usecase.ts'
jobs:
  deployment-summary:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'
          
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
        
      - name: Run lint checks
        run: npm run lint
        
      - name: Run tests
        run: npm run test:api
        
      - name: Generate deployment summary
        run: |
          echo "## Deployment Summary" > deployment-summary.md
          echo "### Changes" >> deployment-summary.md
          echo "- Fixed duplicate Novu branding when switching from block to HTML editor" >> deployment-summary.md
          echo "- Prevented duplicate 'Powered by Novu' branding in email templates" >> deployment-summary.md
          echo "" >> deployment-summary.md
          echo "### Files Modified" >> deployment-summary.md
          echo "- apps/api/src/app/workflows-v2/usecases/upsert-workflow/upsert-workflow.usecase.ts" >> deployment-summary.md
          echo "" >> deployment-summary.md
          echo "### Technical Details" >> deployment-summary.md
          echo "- Added \`removeBrandingFromHtml\` private method using regex pattern: \`/ ]*data-novu-branding[^>]*>[\s\S]*? /gi\`" >> deployment-summary.md
          echo "- Modified \`executeControlValuesUpdate\` method to strip branding after preview generation" >> deployment-summary.md
          echo "- Implemented proper error handling for malformed HTML scenarios" >> deployment-summary.md
          echo "" >> deployment-summary.md
          echo "### Testing" >> deployment-summary.md
          echo "- Verified regex pattern correctly identifies and removes branding elements" >> deployment-summary.md
          echo "- Tested edge cases including multiple branding elements and malformed HTML" >> deployment-summary.md
          echo "- API service lint checks passed successfully" >> deployment-summary.md
          echo "- Existing E2E test for editor type switching continues to work" >> deployment-summary.md
          echo "" >> deployment-summary.md
          echo "### Related" >> deployment-summary.md
          echo "- Fixes NV-6101" >> deployment-summary.md
          echo "- Requested by pawel@novu.co" >> deployment-summary.md
          
      - name: Upload deployment summary
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: deployment-summary
          path: deployment-summary.md
